D: Two brothers who work in their dad's fake plant shop try every night to get into the hottest club in LA.
P: Serve the snacks when the Butabi brothers finally make it past the door.
S: Mini cheeseburgers with dill pickles on slider buns
Little beef sliders with cheese and pickles on soft buns, the kind of thing you eat standing up in a club.
Carrot, celery, cucumber and capsicum sticks with a herb sour cream dip
A real garden of crisp raw vegetables standing up in a jar, with a green herb dip, nothing fake about it.
M: Smoky chipotle lime chicken thighs in warm tortillas

Chipotle and lime chicken thighs chargrilled and sliced into soft tortillas with smashed avocado, pickled red onion, coriander and a squeeze of lime. Mix 2 tbsp chipotle in adobo, 2 crushed garlic cloves, the juice of 1 lime, 1 tsp cumin and 2 tbsp oil. Marinate 800g chicken thigh fillets for 30 minutes. Slice 1 red onion thin and soak in lime juice and salt for 20 minutes. Grill the chicken on a hot barbecue for 5 minutes a side and slice. Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt. Warm 12 small tortillas and fill with avocado, chicken, onion and coriander.
Benny Zadir, the club owner who loves the brothers' idea for a club

Grilled lamb and onion kebabs with saffron rice, charred tomatoes and yoghurt with herbs. Grate the onion, squeeze out the juice and mix with the lamb, turmeric and salt until sticky. Shape around 8 flat skewers. Soak the saffron in 2 tbsp hot water. Simmer the rice with 600ml water, covered, for 12 minutes, rest for 5, then stir through the saffron and butter. Grill the kebabs and halved tomatoes on a hot grill for 5 minutes a side. Mix the yoghurt with chopped mint and salt. Dust the kebabs with sumac and serve on the rice with the tomatoes, yoghurt and parsley.
W: Biscuit base and raspberry cream cheese mousse in glasses

Buttery biscuit crumb under a whipped no-bake cream cheese filling swirled with raspberry, topped with fresh raspberries and white chocolate shavings. Crush 150g plain sweet biscuits and mix with 60g melted butter. Press into 6 glasses. Blitz 150g raspberries with 2 tbsp icing sugar and strain. Beat 250g cream cheese with 80g icing sugar and 1 tsp vanilla, then fold in 200ml whipped cream. Fold half the raspberry sauce through to turn it pink. Spoon into the glasses, swirl the rest of the sauce on top and chill 2 hours. Finish with raspberries and grated white chocolate.
K: Vodka, orange liqueur, cranberry and lime, shaken and served up
Vodka, orange liqueur, cranberry and lime shaken and served up, pink and very nineties. Cranberry soda for the kids.
